name: y2_plateau_noise_ceiling
label: EXPLORATORY / post-hoc. Plateau cut (can>=60, square>=90) chosen by looking at learning curves.

conventions.target: held-out half B = training-time rollouts seeds 100025-100049 (25 episodes)
conventions.reference_more_rollouts: half A = seeds 100000-100024 (K25), random 10-subsets of A (K10)
conventions.orientation: all signals oriented higher=better (costs negated, epoch later=better)
conventions.within_run: statistics computed within run, then unweighted mean over runs; runs whose target is constant within the subset are skipped (NaN)
conventions.regret_ties: Regret@30 ties broken uniformly at random (exact expectation)
conventions.block_bootstrap: circular moving blocks of ceil(n^(1/3)) (min 2) epoch-consecutive checkpoints within run
conventions.hier_bootstrap: block bootstrap x resampling of seeds (B within B, A within A, eval seeds) jointly across runs
conventions.run_level: exact bootstrap over the 3 runs (27 resamples) -- very coarse
